item.title: Building Aside: a private on-device AI chat in 13 builds
item.description: iOS chat app on top of Apple Intelligence's FoundationModels — no cloud, no API key, no account. Five AI integrations (Image Playground, Writing Tools, Translate, Summarize, Smart Reply) stitched into one chat. ~2,800 lines of SwiftUI + SwiftData.
